scope: Complete tracked-file inventory, all production TS/JS modules structurally scanned, subsystem tracing and executed gates; not a line-by-line correctness or penetration audit.
methods: Per-file inspection is a minimum documented method, not a coverage percentage or certification. Semantic-path tracing does not assert every line in that file was examined.
